episodes.title: A - Alçakdam Yokuşu
episodes.summary: Zehra travels to the bustling city of Istanbul, ready to embrace a whole new world. But is she truly prepared for the challenges that lie ahead?

episodes.title: B - Bezm-i Alem Valide Sultan Camii
episodes.summary: Balancing her religious beliefs with her new social life proves difficult for Zehra. Meanwhile Nesrin faces her own personal struggles.

episodes.title: C - Çarşanba Sokağı
episodes.summary: Homeless and scared, Zehra finds refuge in an unexpected place. Nesrin loses her cat, Diego, and scours the city in search of her dear companion.

episodes.title: D - Deniz Hastanesi
episodes.summary: Zehra's lies put a strain on her relationship with Harun, as she wrestles with making choices that align with her once-immovable morals.

episodes.title: E - Emek Sineması
episodes.summary: Nesrin faces public scrutiny when a video of her is posted online, revealing a heated argument with the aggrieved family of a patient.

episodes.title: F - Fener, Fenerler, Deniz Feneri
episodes.summary: When Zehra receives difficult news from her mother, Nesrin drives her home — finally coming face-to-face with Aylin and the consequences of her choices.

episodes.title: G - Galata Rıhtımı Salaşları, Tiyatro ve Meyhaneleri
episodes.summary: When Zehra needs to get a new ID photo taken, all of her inner struggles around identity come to the surface. She turns to Nesrin for guidance.

episodes.title: Son Harf
episodes.summary: As Nesrin packs up her life once again, Zehra expresses her struggles with duality — the strain and pain behind living a double life — on stage.
